decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( 604_PL020 REV A (Received on the 21.03.2014), 604_PL021, 604_PL019 REV C, 604_PL016, 604_PL006, 604_PL018, 604_PL015, 604_PL010, 604_PL009, 604_PL007, 604_PL008 REV C, 604_PL004, 604_PL005, 604_PL006, 604_PL003, 604_PL001  received on the 10.02.14  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the drawings hereby approved, full details shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing prior to commencement of development (other than demolition) unless non material changes are otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The development shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with the details thus approved.

a.	Bricks;
b.	Rooflights
c.	Sliding doors and
d.	Roof tiles

Condition : 5 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of  a single storey rear extension and extension to existing basement
